constants.note: EY_REF = median monthly E/P 1950-01..1999-12; CAPE_Q90 = 90th percentile of monthly CAPE 1871-01..1999-12; V4_C matches V4's mean target weight to K's on the ^NDX calibration window

frozen_signal_robustness.note: report only, not a gate: (a) no tilt where the published figure is stale (decisions from 2024-08-01), (b) the fresh-signal window only

gate_definitions.G1: pre-tax m=2 CAGR >= K, or (Calmar >= 1.1x K and CAGR >= K - 0.5 pp); base and calibrated
gate_definitions.G2: pre-tax m=2 max DD <= K + 1.0 pp; base and calibrated
gate_definitions.G3: 2017-01-03 -> end CAGR >= K - 1 pp; base and calibrated
gate_definitions.G5: main block-20 bootstrap (seed 20261011, 5000 paths, m=2, both models): median (arm - K) >= 0
gate_definitions.G6: G1 at m=1; base and calibrated
gate_definitions.G7: 3 US OOS windows (reduced): median (arm - K) CAGR >= 0, >= 2/3 within -0.5 pp, DD <= K+3 pp in >= 2/3 and never > K+8 pp
gate_definitions.G8: unavailable: e2_confirmation_v1 K5 pooled OOS bootstrap is not ported into research/fast_engine (reduced gate, see PREREGISTRATION.md)
gate_definitions.after_tax: beats K at $100k in all three windows AND B1-recent/B2-flat median >= 0 with share > 0 >= 55%
gate_definitions.tier: exposure-neutral (+-1.0 pp of K's mean weight) -> G5 median >= -0.05 pp and G9 only
